Canadian open data for OpenStreetMap

Datasets · Portals · Summary · Wiki view · CSVs

Where Alberta and British Columbia and New Brunswick and Nova Scotia and Ontario and Prince Edward Island publish open data: the denominator the catalogue grows towards. 542 of 1152 municipalities have data reachable on a portal or map server. Reach grades how good the data is likely to be, by how it is published: 4 its own catalogue, 3 listed in a county catalogue, 2 layers on a map server no catalogue lists, 1 a viewer only, 0 nothing found. Catalogued counts the datasets taken from each portal; follow the number to see them.

Langley Townshipmunicipal4 ownarcgis-hubdata-tol.opendata.arcgis.com5,5915,722
Open Data Licence
2026-11-03
Township of Langley (data.tol.ca redirects here; org frpHL0Fv8koQRVWY): 5,591 items, 5,447 of them Images (probably orthophoto tiles), so about 144 others. The Images say CC BY 4.0; the feature services and CAD link tol.ca/opengovlicense, the Township's Open Data Licence, 'based on version 2.0 of the Open Government License - Canada'. A few utility and tree items carry a disclaimer instead.
British Columbiaprovince4 ownckancatalogue.data.gov.bc.ca3,3643,364
Open Government Licence - British Columbia
2026-11-03
The BC Data Catalogue (CKAN, dataset type bcdc_dataset), 164 organisations. Each record carries its own licence: Open Government Licence - British Columbia on 1,685, Access Only on 1,450, then Statistics Canada Open Licence 86, OGL-Canada 62 and 13 others. 2,445 records have download audience Public, 465 Government, 223 not downloadable, 60 named users. It is the superset: 2,442 BC Geographic Warehouse object names, 889 of them public on openmaps. openmaps.gov.bc.ca (GeoServer, WMS and WFS) is the server behind it: 899 layers, 889 of them catalogue records, so it has no row of its own.
Monctonmunicipal4 ownarcgis-hubopen.moncton.ca3,0243,018
Open Data Terms of Use
2026-11-02
City of Moncton Open Data Hub, linked as Open Data from https://www.moncton.ca/en (French mirror https://ouvert.moncton.ca, 3001 items). Of 3024 items, 2933 are Document Links and PDFs (council agendas, decisions, public notices, activity reports); the geographic part is 56 feature services, 21 web maps and a few apps (zoning, addresses, hydrants, trees, bus routes and stops, council districts). The Open Data Terms of Use is attached to 80 items; the rest carry no licence.
